name: Docker Desktop
description: Container development environment for Windows with Docker Engine, Compose and Kubernetes.
longDescription: Docker Desktop provides containerized development on Windows. It is an advanced installation: it requires administrator permission, hardware virtualization, and usually WSL 2. A reboot and a Docker account sign-in are commonly required before containers can run.
caveats: Docker Desktop requires WSL 2 or Hyper-V and hardware virtualization enabled in firmware.
A system restart and Docker account sign-in are typically required before Docker works.
DevForge only installs the package and verifies the CLI; it does not configure WSL, Hyper-V or your Docker account.
This is an advanced optional integration and should be treated separately from a basic development environment.
